# Let's parse all habit notes and build the data structure
import re

# note_ids is a list of note IDs (from previous steps)
# We'll read each note and extract date and habit values
habit_data = {}  # date -> {habit: value}
habit_order = None

for nid in note_ids:
    note = apis.simple_note.show_note(access_token=access_token, note_id=nid)
    title = note['title']
    # Extract date from title: "Habit Tracking Log for YYYY-MM-DD"
    m = re.search(r'(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})', title)
    if not m:
        continue
    date = m.group(1)
    content = note['content']
    lines = content.split('\n')
    # Skip the first line (title) and any empty lines
    habits = {}
    for line in lines:
        line = line.strip()
        if not line or ':' not in line:
            continue
        # Skip the header line if it contains "Daily Habit Tracker"
        if 'Daily Habit Tracker' in line:
            continue
        parts = line.split(':', 1)
        habit = parts[0].strip()
        value = parts[1].strip().lower()
        habits[habit] = value
    if habit_order is None:
        # Capture the order of habits as they appear in this note
        habit_order = []
        for line in lines:
            line = line.strip()
            if not line or ':' not in line or 'Daily Habit Tracker' in line:
                continue
            habit = line.split(':', 1)[0].strip()
            habit_order.append(habit)
    habit_data[date] = habits
